definitions.def: a feeling of strain that seeks to be resolved
a short piece of music that comes before a larger work
the state of having more than one possible meaning
coming after something else in order
able to be known or expected in advance

grammar_choice.en_template: Music can {{1:bring/brings}} us into a very comfortable rhythm, and it can be {{2:satisfying/satisfied}} in and of itself.

grammar_choice.en_template: Most of the time, however, we want {{1:something more/more something}} {{2:to happen/happening}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그러나 대부분의 경우 우리는 무언가 더 일어나기를 원한다.
explain: -thing 으로 끝나는 대명사는 수식어를 뒤에 둠 → something more.

grammar_choice.en_template: There needs {{1:to be/being}} a process {{2:that/what}} creates tension and drives the movement towards something in particular.

explain: 선행사 a process 를 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 → that.

grammar_choice.en_template: The excitement that {{1:arises/arise}} in this process {{2:creates/create}} satisfaction and pleasure.

explain: 선행사 The excitement(단수)에 수를 일치 → arises.

grammar_choice.en_template: This {{1:is seen/sees}} in the measureless prelude as {{2:well/good}}.

grammar_choice.en_template: But there the tension might {{1:be caused/cause}} by the {{2:ambiguity/ambiguous}} of the rhythm.

grammar_choice.en_template: This, in turn, creates new and other types of tensions, {{1:where/which}} the rhythm is unambiguous and predictable, but where unexpected chords and modulations {{2:create/creates}} drama and an experience of development in the piece.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 이것은 결과적으로 새롭고 다른 유형의 긴장을 만들어 내는데, 그곳에서는 리듬이 모호하지 않고 예측 가능하지만, 예상치 못한 화음과 전조가 그 곡에서 극적 요소와 전개의 경험을 만들어 낸다.

jumble.answer: Music can bring us into a very comfortable rhythm, and it can be satisfying in and of itself.
Most of the time, however, we want something more to happen.
There needs to be a process that creates tension and drives the movement towards something in particular.
The excitement that arises in this process creates satisfaction and pleasure.
This is seen in the measureless prelude as well.
But there the tension might be caused by the ambiguity of the rhythm.
Therefore, the fluid movement in the prelude usually creates a tension that can be released in the subsequent movement with a set rhythm.

This, in turn, creates new and other types of tensions, where the rhythm is unambiguous and predictable, but where unexpected chords and modulations create drama and an experience of development in the piece.
